text: I don't have much of a script for this video. A few weeks ago, I saw a clip of a Japanese inventor
who's been running his own “Micro Hovercraft Laboratory” for years.
So I asked my local producer in Japan to get in touch and ask while I'm in the country, can I please meet the inventor?
Can I see the hovercraft and maybe have a go flying it?
So now we've taken a bullet train to Tsubame City, two hours north of Tokyo,
and I'm going to meet Hideyasu Ito at the local sports center.
Now, I do have a little bit of experience with hovercraft...
but this is one person's home-made vehicle, so... I'm going to be careful not to break it.
Hello. Could you demonstrate? Could you show me around? Thank you.
